body: ※27⛬ stood on the bustling street, his gaze falling involuntarily on the three ※30⛬ eggs in his hands, thinking to himself:
"It is simply too risky to wander around with these ※30⛬ eggs. If something goes wrong, the loss would be immense."
He frowned slightly, his expression grave, and carefully pulled the ※30⛬ eggs closer to his chest, as if this could provide them with more protection.
"These eggs are quite valuable. Eggs of ※15⛬ ※29⛬ ※12⛬ and ※14⛬ can sell for around 100,000 at the breeding house, not to mention that ※5⛬ ※16⛬ egg, which is worth more than two or three million."
Thinking of this, a flash of hesitation crossed his eyes,

"I once thought about selling the ※16⛬ egg to make things easier, but I am just a child. Carrying such precious items for trade is like a sheep entering a tiger's den; it might even bring about fatal disaster."
※27⛬ sighed helplessly and shook his head,
"Safety comes first. At worst, I can try my luck at the breeding house's egg-gambling area later to find some ※15⛬ ※29⛬ eggs to sell. Although the money is less, the risk is much smaller."
Having made up his mind, ※27⛬ quickened his pace, rushing toward his home in the suburbs.
Along the way, he vigilantly observed his surroundings from time to time, and only when the familiar small house appeared before his eyes did he breathe a slight sigh of relief.
Just as he entered the house and placed the purchased ※30⛬ eggs into the incubator, ※10⛬ rushed toward the TV like a gust of wind, its little claws excitedly pressing buttons on the remote control.
Seeing this, ※27⛬ immediately raised his voice and shouted:
"※10⛬, your training for today is not finished yet. How can you be thinking of watching TV? Go train immediately!"
His voice carried unquestionable authority, his brows tightly furrowed, and he stared sternly at ※24⛬.
Hearing ※27⛬'s reprimand, ※24⛬'s originally joyful movements froze instantly, and its whole body slumped like a deflated balloon.
It turned its head and looked at ※27⛬ pitifully with those big, watery eyes, making a grievance-filled sound:
"Sand... Sand..." The appearance seemed to be saying,
"Master, I just want to watch for a little while."
※27⛬ crossed his arms, unmoved, and glared fiercely at ※10⛬, his gaze leaving no room for compromise.
※10⛬ seemed to read ※27⛬'s eyes and knew that watching TV was out of the question today, so it had to drag its feet dejectedly toward the yard.
It turned its head three times for every step, its eyes constantly fixed on the TV. This reluctant expression made ※27⛬ both annoyed and amused.
※27⛬ watched ※10⛬'s retreating back, shook his head helplessly, and thought to himself:
"This ※6〓, it only knows how to play. But its potential is not small, so it must be trained well."
He walked to the window, looked at ※10⛬ in the yard, and began to plan today's training content.
"First, I must exercise its physical fitness. Once its physical fitness improves, it can fight for a long time in battle."
※27⛬ muttered to himself, his eyes focused and determined.
"Then comes the use of ※36⛬s, especially that divine skill, ※17⛬. I must let it unleash its maximum power."

"There were three main reasons why I decided to train this ※11⛬."
"First, at that time, I was penniless and couldn't afford good ※30⛬ at all. This ※15⛬ ※29⛬ ※11⛬ appeared on its own, like a god-sent opportunity, so naturally, I had to train it well."

"Second, I have studied ※30⛬ ※32〓 rates. Apart from the ※28⛬, rodent-like ※30⛬ grow very fast. This ※11⛬ has good ※29⛬, and it only needs to reach ※37⛬ 22 to evolve into ※10⛬, which can allow me to improve my strength in a short time."
"Third, this ※11⛬ inherited the precious ※17⛬ ※36⛬."
※27⛬ narrowed his eyes, recalling the experience of inquiring about the value of the ※17⛬ ※36⛬, and couldn't help but click his tongue.
"The ※36⛬ discs sold in the city are priced differently according to the ※36⛬'s power."
"Those with power below 60 are priced under 100,000;"
"Those between 60-90 range from 100,000 to 200,000;"
"Those between 90-120 range from 200,000 to 500,000."

"The shop didn't have any with higher power. From my inquiries, I learned that ※17⛬, a status-changing ※36⛬ that can increase attack by two levels, is worth at least 500,000 coins or more, and it's even priceless and hard to obtain."
"So, the fact that this ※11⛬ knows ※17⛬ is like finding 500,000 for nothing for me."
"※10⛬, run 20 laps around the yard first to warm up your body!"
※27⛬ opened the window and gave the order loudly to ※10⛬ in the yard. His voice was loud, powerful, and full of expectation.
Hearing the command, although somewhat reluctant, ※10⛬ still obediently began to run.
Its short legs alternated quickly. With every lap it ran, its eyes became a bit more determined, as if it were secretly cheering itself on.
※27⛬ nodded with satisfaction, turned back into the house, picked up a training notebook, and began to record.
"After it finishes running, I will have it practice the two ※36⛬s: ※17⛬ and ※38⛬."
"※38⛬ can attack the enemy by surprise, and combined with the attack power boost from ※17⛬, it will surely catch the opponent off guard."
He muttered to himself while writing, his eyes flashing with the light of wisdom.
"However, training cannot be rushed. It must be progressive. Even if I have ※0⛬, I still have to avoid ※10⛬ getting injured."

In the process of recording the training plan, ※27⛬ looked out the window from time to time, paying attention to ※10⛬'s training situation. Seeing ※10⛬'s hardworking figure, a gratified smile appeared on his face.

※27⛬ carefully examined the information of these three eggs in the ※33⛬ and pondered secretly. He found that all three eggs possessed inherited ※36⛬s, which was truly good.
